description: Model-output telemetry evidence in RAI impact assessments
applyTo: '**/.copilot-tracking/rai-plans/**'
---

# RAI Telemetry

Capture model-output latency, refusal rate, and content-filter triggers in the impact-assessment record. Use duration histograms with documented units and counters with bounded outcomes for rates. Follow the service's documented semantic conventions; never export prompts, completions, identifiers, credentials, or personal data as attributes. Flag unavailable measurements rather than estimating them.
